title: Scientific build and validation obligations preserved from operational wrappers
scope: Independent curated summaries, not runnable remote-control scripts. No connection details, private paths or credentials.
status: Source inspection only; no new compile, collision search or verifier execution.

scientific_preservation: A measured run is accepted only when its memory report has exit equal to zero and failed false.
Collected collision data are independently checked by verify_collision.py before the package is built.

The script asserts that claimed mem_bytes is at least the measured peak_bytes of the counted run. It separately warns that development, probe and duplicate runs must also fit the declared peak; that latter obligation is not proved by the single assertion.

Preserve these conditions and local collector/verifier dependencies in a clean scientific account. Do not publish or execute the connection, process-management, staging or interactive approval wrapper.
The source list for the no-libc Poseidon executable: single.c, common.c, ntt.c, poly.c, lean.c, line.c, split.c, hgcd.c, pallas.c, par.c and nolibc.c, with their included headers.

Compiler configuration includes -O3, -march=native, -mcmodel=medium, -static, -nostdlib, -fno-stack-protector, -fno-pie, -no-pie and section garbage collection. Architecture-dependent flags require a stated build environment; these are historical flags, not a portable command promise.
The wrapper records source and binary hashes and executable size. Preserve those provenance steps without remote addresses, private paths or credential options.
Preserve the collect.py to verify_collision.py to build_package.py dependency sequence as a local reproduction guide.
Retain binary hash/size and measured memory provenance; remove machine-specific fetching and output destinations.
collect.py reads the completed run into collision data; verify_collision.py independently checks the run before build_package.py consumes it.
The wrapper also records executable hash/size and memory output. Its prefile/rule checking and staging are operational release steps, not the collision proof.
Keep these scientific Python sources and their local data dependencies separately reviewed; omit remote fetch configuration and automatic package-staging behavior.
